name: Miscarriage
overview: Scripture acknowledges the deep sorrow and loss experienced through miscarriage, affirming that God is sovereign over life and death, as seen in Job's acceptance that the Lord gives and takes away. The Lord draws near to the brokenhearted and those who are crushed in spirit, offering comfort and strength in times of grief. God's intimate knowledge and care for life from the womb is evident, for He forms and sanctifies each person even before birth. Though human compassion may falter, God's unfailing remembrance and sustaining presence provide hope and reassurance to those mourning a lost child.
